description.zh: 分组ID，分组的全局唯一标识符。
description.en: The ID of the group. The ID is the globally unique identifier (GUID) for the group.

description.zh:
分组类型。

传入**LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**时，表示动态分组。不传入时，默认为静态分组。
description.en:
The type of the group.

If you set the value to **LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**, a dynamic group is queried. If you do not specify this parameter, a static group is queried by default.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为500。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can run a maximum of 500 queries per second (QPS).

>  RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-group-tag-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --group-id W16X8Tvdosec0000 --group-type LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
